overview.en:
## What is on this page

Every Punjab Police Constable question paper published here, one row per year,
with the official answer key beside it and a download for each file. The
answer-key cell reads *Not published* until the conducting body releases one -
it is never reconstructed from memory, and a paper appears as soon as it
exists rather than waiting for its key.

## About the exam

Constable is the highest-volume recruitment on the Punjab list, which is why
the papers below are worth more than another mock: they are the only record of
what the board actually asked. Build the base first - Punjab GK and current
affairs - then drill reasoning until speed is automatic. Attempt the first
paper after one full pass of the syllabus, untimed; the second strictly timed.

overview.en:
## What is on this page

One row for every year this exam has been held: the question paper and the
official answer key beside it, each with a download. The files are the ones
the conducting body released. Where a key has not been published yet the cell
reads *Not published* - it is never filled in from memory, and a paper is
never held back while it waits for its key.

## About the exam

Head Constable is the communication and clerical tier of Punjab Police.
Punjabi, English and general knowledge carry the paper, and computer
awareness is worth real marks. Attempt the first paper untimed, to learn the
shape of the thing; attempt the second strictly timed, to learn what the
clock will do to you on exam day. Separate every mistake into a concept gap
or a speed gap before you move on.
overview.pa:
## ਇਸ ਪੰਨੇ ਵਿੱਚ ਕੀ ਹੈ

ਹਰ ਸਾਲ ਲਈ ਇੱਕ ਲਾਈਨ: ਪ੍ਰਸ਼ਨ ਪੱਤਰ ਅਤੇ ਉਸ ਦੇ ਨਾਲ ਅਧਿਕਾਰਿਤ ਉੱਤਰ-ਕੁੰਜੀ, ਦੋਵਾਂ ਦਾ
ਡਾਊਨਲੋਡ। ਜਿਸ ਸਾਲ ਉੱਤਰ-ਕੁੰਜੀ ਜਾਰੀ ਨਹੀਂ ਹੋਈ, ਉਸ ਥਾਂ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਹੈ *ਜਾਰੀ ਨਹੀਂ ਕੀਤਾ ਗਿਆ* -
ਇਹ ਕਦੇ ਵੀ ਅੰਦਾਜ਼ੇ ਨਾਲ ਨਹੀਂ ਭਰਿਆ ਜਾਂਦਾ, ਅਤੇ ਪੇਪਰ ਉੱਤਰ-ਕੁੰਜੀ ਦੀ ਉਡੀਕ ਵਿੱਚ ਰੁਕਦਾ ਨਹੀਂ।

## ਪੇਪਰ ਬਾਰੇ

ਹੈੱਡ ਕਾਂਸਟੇਬਲ ਪੰਜਾਬ ਪੁਲਿਸ ਦਾ ਸੰਚਾਰ ਅਤੇ ਦਫ਼ਤਰੀ ਪੱਧਰ ਹੈ। ਪੰਜਾਬੀ, ਅੰਗਰੇਜ਼ੀ ਅਤੇ
ਜਨਰਲ ਨਾਲੇ ਕੰਪਿਊਟਰ ਜਾਣਕਾਰੀ ਦੀ ਵੀ ਪੇਪਰ ਵਿੱਚ ਅਹਿਮੀਅਤ ਹੈ। ਪਹਿਲਾਂ ਬਿਨਾਂ ਸਮੇਂ ਹੱਲ ਕਰੋ,
ਫਿਰ ਸਟਾਪਵਾਚ ਨਾਲ, ਅਤੇ ਅੱਗੇ ਵਧਣ ਤੋਂ ਪਹਿਲਾਂ ਹਰ ਗ਼ਲਤੀ ਨੂੰ ਸਮਝ ਦੀ ਘਾਟ ਜਾਂ ਰਫ਼ਤਾਰ ਦੀ ਘਾਟ
ਵਿੱਚ ਵੰਡੋ।

## What is on this page

One row for every year with a paper in this folder: the question paper and the
official answer key beside it, each with a download. The files are the ones
the conducting body released. Where a key has not been published yet the cell
reads *Not published* - it is never filled in from memory, and a paper is
never held back while it waits for its key.

## About the exam

The papers below are the ones released for this post, so they are the only
honest description of what is actually asked - treat them as the syllabus's
proof rather than as a mock with a score attached. Read one untimed before
you plan your preparation, so that the syllabus you work through is the one
the paper tests. Attempt each one afterwards under a strict clock, and mark
it only against an official key: until a key appears in the table, the paper
is practice, not a score.
